title: HAEF generic structure comparison
question: How does generic Yosys structure change between the conventional ALU baseline, shared add/subtract arithmetic, and the shared datapath with a dedicated one-entry prepared-instruction buffer?

A.description: Conventional addition and subtraction paths; no extra prepare/execute state

B.description: Shared add/subtract arithmetic; no extra prepare/execute state

C.description: Shared arithmetic plus a dedicated one-entry prepared-instruction buffer

frozen_conditions.source_hash: SHA-256 over relative path, NUL byte, source bytes, NUL byte for each sorted RTL file

acceptance.functional: All unit and processor-level Cocotb cases pass for A, B, and C against the independent reference model.
acceptance.structural: All lint and synthesis runs pass, and every variant reports the same RTL source hash and tool version.
acceptance.claim_boundary: Generic cell counts only; no inference of physical area, timing, power, energy, or workload performance.
